F011 is implemented and committed as `f601e68`. The `docs/AGENT_CAPABILITY_MATRIX.md` vocabulary section was expanded from the earlier three-layer stub into the four Track D0 concepts — harness, model, worker profile, and role — including the layered text diagram, the rule that `AGENT_REGISTRY` is the harness adapter table whose keys are never model names (Grok 4.5 / OpenRouter slugs / Ollama tags are explicitly called out as catalog entries requiring no Python change), capability-flag role gating (`implementer` requires `file_edit` + `tool_use` + `non_interactive`), and the reading of legacy `roles.implementer: "claude"` as shorthand for the default `claude_cli` profile. The README agent section cross-links to the vocabulary section anchor. A repo-wide grep confirmed no doc instructs operators to add model version strings to `AGENT_REGISTRY` — the only match is the prohibition itself. The targeted doc-drift guard (`test_doc_drift_guard_f002.py`, 28 tests) passed, and the commit touches only the two doc files, leaving other staged plan artifacts for the supervisor.
